text:
incident-bot: Paging: SEV=P1 - elevated 5xxs and latency spikes from /v1/generate (us-west-2) observed at 2026-03-15T19:02:47Z. Initial alert: token processing backlog growing, node mem pressure.

oncall-jordan: 👀 I'm on it. grabbing logs and dashboards. anyone else seeing similar in eu?

eng-runtime-zach: seeing the same. continuous-batching queue depth jumped ~x25 in last 2m. KV cache size per-shard went from 200MB -> 12GB on shard-7.

sre-maria: this looks like the continuous batching config flipped to a very large max_batch_tokens earlier in the deploy window. digging deploys — found a config change from 4096 -> 32768 rolled 3 mins ago via operator pipeline.

pm-lina: that was a scheduled tuning PR from runtime team (intended for perf tests) — it mistakenly landed in prod. tagging @eng-runtime-zach.

eng-runtime-zach: confirmed, PR #8721 modified default batching values and feature flag. It should not have rolled to prod. Going to revert if we can't hotfix quickly.

oncall-jordan: impact: 5 enterprise customers seeing 500s, average p95 latency from 220ms -> 3.2s, errors per min rose 18x. marking customer-impact=yes.

cust-success-ash: FYI we already have 2 open tickets from customers in us-west complaining about timeouts. escalating to ERT.

sre-maria: short-term mitigation options: 1) toggle feature flag to disable continuous batching 2) patch runtime config to reduce max_batch_tokens and max_num_seqs 3) throttle incoming traffic for affected routes 4) purge KV cache for the hot shard to reclaim memory.

eng-runtime-zach: trying option 2 first to avoid full disable. applying a hotfix: set max_batch_tokens=2048, max_num_seqs=8, request_timeout=30s on shard-7 via admin API.

eng-runtime-zach: executing:
```
# apply hot config to shard-7
curl -X POST "https://admin.us-west-2.redwood.local/shards/7/config" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"max_batch_tokens":2048,"max_num_seqs":8,"request_timeout_ms":30000}'
```

infra-ops-bot: deploy-job-4492: config-patch accepted by shard-7, rolling update started (3 replicas).

oncall-jordan: monitoring mem / queue depth now.

sre-maria: queue depth dropped ~60% within 45s after config patch, error rate falling. KV cache growth stopped and started shrinking on shard-7.

eng-runtime-zach: still seeing occasional spikes — probably stale entries in KV cache causing slow eviction. issuing purge for prefix `continuous_batch/cache/shard-7`

eng-runtime-zach: purge command:
```
curl -X POST "https://admin.us-west-2.redwood.local/kv/purge" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"prefix":"continuous_batch/cache/shard-7"}'
```

infra-ops-bot: kv-purge-job-773 accepted, estimate ~30s.

sre-maria: after purge, memory returned to baseline on shard-7. 5xxs reduced to near-normal within 2m.

pm-lina: next steps: revert the PR in operator pipeline, add stricter merge gates on batching defaults, and add a pre-deploy test blocking large max_batch_tokens for prod. I'll create the follow-up tickets.

cust-success-ash: recording customer impact: 2 premium customers affected for ~6-10 mins, multiple timed-out requests. recommend outreach + incident summary.

eng-runtime-zach: rolling a conservative config to all shards now (max_batch_tokens=1024, max_num_seqs=4) as stopgap. will schedule a controlled canary first (10% of traffic) then full rollout.

oncall-jordan: starting handoff to @sre-maria for overnight monitoring. I'm going offline in 10m. leave me the summary and any regression alerts pinned.

sre-maria: acknowledged. I'll keep an eye on queue depth alerts and KV cache growth. If we see >10% increase in p50 or any 5xx spikes for more than 5m we'll page.

eng-runtime-zach: note for postmortem: root cause = accidental prod rollout of stress-test batching config; contributing = missing merge gate + no pre-deploy eviction sim for KV cache; mitigation = hotfix config + KV purge + revert PR + new gating.

pm-lina: created follow-ups: TICKET-1284 (revert bad PR), TICKET-1285 (merge-gate for batching params), TICKET-1286 (eviction/predeploy sim), TICKET-1287 (customer notifications).

cust-success-ash: drafting customer-facing note now. pls ping me if exact SLA windows needed.

infra-ops-bot: autopilot: canary rollout started for conservative config (10% traffic). will auto-promote if no errors in 5m.

sre-maria: final status: mitigated, impact window ~2026-03-15T19:02:47Z -> 2026-03-15T19:12:00Z. handing off incident to oncall for normal ops.

oncall-jordan: thanks team. leaving notes in pagerduty and will attach graphs. I'm handing off the incident now. :wave:
